name: tension-framework
description: Guest SDK for TensionCore: the capability bindings (tension::io, audio, ai, res, solver, ogre, input, 2d) and the game abstractions built on them

scripts.test: cd .. && node scripts/test.mjs --framework && cargo test --manifest-path tension-core/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features audio --test framework_guards
scripts.assets:fonts: node tools/font/bake-ttf.mjs --spec assets/fonts/fonts.json --atlas assets --manifest assets/ui.json --ts assembly/ui/fonts.generated.ts --preview assets/preview
